corrections.text: The Fedora section describes the Plasma 6.8 update as the point where Fedora 44 users lost the X11 session, and says FESCo voted against reverting the update for Fedora 44. LWN.net's report adds that Fedora's KDE SIG has not supported Plasma X11 since Fedora 40 (2024), that the removed kwin-x11 and plasma-workspace-x11 packages were provided by an independent maintainer under an earlier FESCo decision, and that the revert request covered Fedora 44 and Fedora 45.
The article dates Phoronix's GNOME 50 Alpha report to 15 January 2026. That is the date in Phoronix's byline, which is US Eastern time (8:45 PM EST); in UTC it is 16 January 2026.
